front.title: Recommendations for IPv6 Testing of Applications

author.organization: University of New Hampshire Interoperability Labs
University of New Hampshire Interoperability Labs

abstract.t:
This document provides guidance for application developers and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) providers on how to approach testing for IPv4-only, Dual-stack (IPv4+IPv6), and IPv6-only scenarios, including "IPv6-only-strict" scenarios without any connectivity towards any relevant IPv4 endpoint.
The document also discusses common misconceptions about the degree to which Operating Systems and libraries can abstract IPv6 issues away and explains common regressions to avoid when deploying IPv6 support.
